Method.name: CountAll
Method.Description: Count messages across ALL namespaces in the instance for a time window. pStart/pEnd can be $H ("day,seconds") or timestamp string ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS").
Method.Implementation:
Set total=0
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns=""
Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set total = total + ..CountNamespace(ns,pStart,pEnd) }
Quit total

Method.name: DebugAll
Method.Description: Debug helper: prints per-namespace counts for a window.
Method.Implementation:
Set total=0 Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd)
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Write !,"MessageCounter DebugAll",! Write "Start=",pStart," End=",pEnd,! Write "StartTS=",startTS," EndTS=",endTS,!! Write "Namespace",?18,"Count",?30,"Status",!
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns=""
Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set status="" Set c=..ProbeNamespace(ns,startTS,endTS,.status)
Write ns,?18,c,?30,status,!
Set total = total + c }
Write !,"TOTAL=",total,!! Quit total

Method.name: CountNamespace
Method.Description: Count messages in ONE namespace for a time window.
Method.Implementation: Set status="" Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd) Quit ..ProbeNamespace(pNamespace,startTS,endTS,.status)

Method.name: NormTS
Method.Description: Normalize input timestamp to the string format used by ^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",...) If passed $H (contains a comma), convert with $ZDATETIME(h,3).
Method.Implementation: If ($Get(pTS)[",") Quit $ZDATETIME(pTS,3) Quit $Get(pTS)

Method.name: ToHorolog
Method.Description: Convert input (either $H or timestamp string) to $H
Method.Implementation: If ($Get(pTS)[",") Quit pTS Quit $ZDATETIMEH(pTS,3)

Method.name: Pad2
Method.Description: Pad integer to 2 digits (month)
Method.Implementation: Quit $Select(pN<10:"0"_pN,1:""_pN)

Method.name: ProbeNamespace
Method.Description: Core worker: returns count; sets pStatus with reason.

Method.name: CountUsingTimeCreatedIndex
Method.Description: Fast count using ^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",ts,id)
Method.Implementation:
Set count=0 Set ts=""
For { Set ts=$Order(^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",ts)) Quit:ts=""
; ts < pStartTS <=> pStartTS sorts after ts Continue:(pStartTS ]] ts)
; ts > pEndTS <=> ts sorts after pEndTS Quit:(ts ]] pEndTS)
Set id="" For { Set id=$Order(^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",ts,id)) Quit:id="" Set count=count+1 } }
Quit count

Method.name: CountWeek
Method.Description: Calendar week containing pAnyTS. Week start = Sunday.
Method.Implementation:
Set h=..ToHorolog(pAnyTS) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1)
; 1=Sun..7=Sat Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h)
; Sunday-start week: subtract (dow-1) days Set startDay=day-(dow-1)
Set startH=startDay_",0" Set endH=(startDay+6)_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountWeekMon
Method.Description: Calendar week containing pAnyTS. Week start = Monday.
Method.Implementation:
Set h=..ToHorolog(pAnyTS) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1)
; 1=Sun..7=Sat Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h)
; Monday-start offset: Sun(1)->6, Mon(2)->0, Tue(3)->1, ... Sat(7)->5 Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=day-offset
Set startH=startDay_",0" Set endH=(startDay+6)_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountMonth
Method.Description: Full calendar month containing pAnyTS (1st -> last day).
Method.Implementation:
Set ts=..NormTS(pAnyTS)
Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon)
Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set firstH=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3)
; next month first day If mon=12 { Set nextYear=year+1 Set nextMon=1 } Else { Set nextYear=year Set nextMon=mon+1 }
Set nextMon2=..Pad2(nextMon) Set nextStr=nextYear_"-"_nextMon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set nextH=$ZDATETIMEH(nextStr,3)
; last day = day-before next month first day Set endDay=$Piece(nextH,",",1)-1
Set startH=$Piece(firstH,",",1)_",0" Set endH=endDay_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountWTD
Method.Description: Week-to-date (Monday -> NOW)
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1)
; 1=Sun..7=Sat Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h)
; Monday-start offset Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=day-offset
Set startH=startDay_",0" Set endH=h
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountMTD
Method.Description: Month-to-date (1st -> NOW)
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon)
Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set startH=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3)
Set endH=..ToHorolog(pNow)
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: GetSummaryJSON
Method.Description: One-call JSON summary (ALL are "to date"): { "as_of":"...", "day_to_date":N, "week_to_date":N, "month_to_date":N }
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; ----- DAY-TO-DATE (00:00 -> NOW) ----- Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set dayEnd=h Set day=..CountAll(dayStart,dayEnd)
; ----- WTD (Mon -> NOW) ----- Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtdEnd=h Set wtd=..CountAll(wtdStart,wtdEnd)
; ----- MTD (1st -> NOW) ----- Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon)
Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtdEnd=h Set mtd=..CountAll(mtdStart,mtdEnd)
Quit "{""as_of"":"""_ts_""",""day_to_date"":"_day_",""week_to_date"":"_wtd_",""month_to_date"":"_mtd_"}"

Method.name: GetSummaryJSONByNamespace
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; ----- DAY-TO-DATE window ----- Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set dayEnd=h
; ----- WTD (Mon -> NOW) window ----- Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) ; 1=Sun..7=Sat Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtdEnd=h
; ----- MTD (1st -> NOW) window ----- Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon) Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtdEnd=h
; ----- Build breakdowns ----- Kill dayCounts,dayExcluded,wtdCounts,wtdExcluded,mtdCounts,mtdExcluded Set dayTotal=0, wtdTotal=0, mtdTotal=0
Do ..BuildWindowCounts(dayStart,dayEnd,.dayCounts,.dayExcluded,.dayTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(wtdStart,wtdEnd,.wtdCounts,.wtdExcluded,.wtdTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(mtdStart,mtdEnd,.mtdCounts,.mtdExcluded,.mtdTotal)
; ----- JSON assemble ----- Set json="{" Set json=json_"""as_of"":"""_..JsonEsc(ts)_"""," Set json=json_"""day_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(dayTotal,.dayCounts,.dayExcluded)_"," Set json=json_"""week_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(wtdTotal,.wtdCounts,.wtdExcluded)_"," Set json=json_"""month_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(mtdTotal,.mtdCounts,.mtdExcluded) Set json=json_"}"
Quit json

Method.name: BuildWindowCounts
Method.Description: Build counts/exclusions for a window across all namespaces. - pCounts(ns)=count (only for count>0) - pExcluded(ns)=status (for count=0 where status is meaningful) - pTotal=total count
Method.Implementation:
Kill pCounts, pExcluded Set pTotal=0
Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd)
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns=""
Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set status="" Set c=..ProbeNamespace(ns,startTS,endTS,.status)
If c>0 { Set pCounts(ns)=c Set pTotal=pTotal+c } Else { ; keep exclusions only if we have a useful status If status'="" Set pExcluded(ns)=status } }
Quit

Method.name: MetricToJSON
Method.Description: Turn one metric into JSON: {"total":N,"by_namespace":{...},"excluded":{...}}
Method.Implementation: Set json="{" Set json=json_"""total"":"_pTotal_"," Set json=json_"""by_namespace"":"_..JsonObjFromNumericArray(.pCounts)_"," Set json=json_"""excluded"":"_..JsonObjFromStringArray(.pExcluded) Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonObjFromNumericArray
Method.Description: JSON object from array values that are NUMERIC: { "EAI":123, "ORDERS":5 }
Method.Implementation:
Set json="{" Set key="" Set first=1 For { Set key=$Order(a(key)) Quit:key=""
If 'first Set json=json_"," Set first=0
Set json=json_""""_..JsonEsc(key)_""":"_+$Get(a(key)) } Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonObjFromStringArray
Method.Description: JSON object from array values that are STRINGS: { "ADTLEGACY":"NO INDEX", ... }
Method.Implementation:
Set json="{" Set key="" Set first=1 For { Set key=$Order(a(key)) Quit:key=""
If 'first Set json=json_"," Set first=0
Set json=json_""""_..JsonEsc(key)_""":"""_..JsonEsc($Get(a(key)))_"""" } Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonEsc
Method.Description: Minimal JSON string escape
Method.Implementation: Set s=$Get(s) Set s=$Replace(s,"\","\\") Set s=$Replace(s,"""","\""") Set s=$Replace(s,$Char(13),"") Set s=$Replace(s,$Char(10),"\n") Quit s

Method.name: PrintSummaryTable
Method.Description: Prints DAY / WTD / MTD with per-namespace columns
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; ----- Windows ----- Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set dayEnd=h
Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtdEnd=h
Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon) Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtdEnd=h
; ----- Build counts ----- Kill dayCounts,wtdCounts,mtdCounts Set dayTotal=0,wtdTotal=0,mtdTotal=0
Do ..BuildWindowCounts(dayStart,dayEnd,.dayCounts,,.dayTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(wtdStart,wtdEnd,.wtdCounts,,.wtdTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(mtdStart,mtdEnd,.mtdCounts,,.mtdTotal)
; ----- Collect namespaces ----- Kill seen Set n=""
Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(dayCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" }
Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(wtdCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" }
Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(mtdCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" }
; ----- Print ----- Write !!,"Message Summary (as of ",ts,")",! Write "Namespace",?25,"DAY",?40,"WTD",?55,"MTD",!
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(seen(ns)) Quit:ns=""
Write ns Write ?25,+$Get(dayCounts(ns)) Write ?40,+$Get(wtdCounts(ns)) Write ?55,+$Get(mtdCounts(ns)) Write ! }
Write !,"TOTAL" Write ?25,dayTotal Write ?40,wtdTotal Write ?55,mtdTotal,!!
Quit
